access_order: Verify immutable cache identity and transport receipt without opening ZIP.
Create one exclusive geometry claim binding source lock, this contract, cache identity, transport receipt, scanner implementation, and reused geometry implementation.
After the claim exists, read ZIP metadata, pose.txt, and referenced depth PNG members only.
Do not read RGB pixels or any RGB-algorithm outcome.

window_rule.anchor: earliest exact timestamp-stem intersection of color/*.png and depth/*.png that can be pose-interpolated
window_rule.partition: consecutive non-overlapping half-open 10.0-second windows from anchor; omit a final incomplete window
window_rule.pair_universe: source-consecutive exact timestamp-stem RGB-depth intersection rows within each window, each pose-interpolable, with 0 < dt <= 0.100 seconds
window_rule.pair_sampling: if more than 24 candidate pairs exist, choose 24 unique source-order indices floor(k*(N-1)/23), k=0..23; otherwise use all
window_rule.selection_after_geometry: admit the source if one or more windows pass; bind the earliest passing window as the development canary; report every evaluated window and denominator

geometry.pose_convention: CID-SIMS pose.txt camera-to-world position plus quaternion xyzw

authority_limits: A successful result identifies real RGB-D plus pose data containing a deterministic positive-approach development window.
The selected window and the entire floor3 capture family are excluded from confirmation.
No RGB algorithm execution, performance qualification, product claim, or user-safety claim is authorized.
